functions.name: writeRgb555Pixel
functions.signature: (type $t14) (param $p0 i32) (param $p1 i32) (param $p2 i32) (param $p3 i32) (param $p4 i32) (param $p5 i32) (param $p6 i32) (param $p7 i32) (result i32)
functions.notes: Expands six-bit green through 132496 and five-bit red/blue through 132560; modes 1/2/4 blend, saturate and multiply; other modes copy.

validation.comparison: Every case checks the call result and written RGB555 word. 16 cases compare all 67,108,864 memory bytes and the stack pointer. Coverage includes modes -1..8, five source words, four colour triples with wrapped operands, alpha variants, coordinates, all 64 green table entries and boundary traps.
limitations: Callers own surface descriptors and pixel addresses.
Both palette tables must be populated, as in the original.
Mode 1 uses the original 0x0FE0 green mask and mode 2 uses 0x0FE0, preserving their carry behaviour.
Ledger: 341 client bodies recovered and 3,904 remain machine code.
